text: Shh! Don't step on the crabs, they're in conference.
Oh. You're not a crab. Pity, crabs are better listeners. Still, Wren's not fussy.
Castaway. Professional. My ship went down chasing a Driftstone three islands west of here. Or east. Islands move.
Washed up in this cove with an eyepatch I definitely didn't have before. Lovely place.
Smugglers. Five of them, south along the sand, with a rowboat and a lot of opinions about who owns this beach.
They took my good bucket. And my second-best bucket. Two of them carry rifles, so don't stroll up waving.
You did that? The crabs held a parade. You missed it. It was very sideways.
I got my buckets back, too. Both of them. You're welcome to visit them any time.
Big black stones with glowing letters. There's one in the ruins, through the jungle, south-west.
Touch it, read it, feel the sea lean in to listen. Every stone points to the next. Like breadcrumbs left by something huge.
Head west from the ruins into the deep green. Someone buried a chest there and drew a terrible map.
And there's gold in the cove, by the water on the far side. The crabs guard it. Poorly.

bye.text: If you find another stone, come tell me what it said! The crabs want to know.
